chapter: In Search of Lost Time: West
act_title: In Search of Lost Time: West

quests.title: In Search of Lost Time: West

dialogue.t: (There's a memo stuck next to the lever on the right side of the console. In neat and elegant handwriting, it reads, "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!")

dialogue.sit:
You pull the lever without the slightest hesitation.
The entire tower then immediately trembles with a thunderous, ear-splitting rumble. It's as if the sky is crumbling and the earth is splitting...

Then... with a pop, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape right into your hands.
All is quiet once more.

dialogue.t: Hmm... Paimon doesn't have a clue what's on it, but it looks pretty important...
{NICKNAME}, why don't we keep this paper tape for now? Who knows, it might come in handy later...
R... Right. It does seem dangerous... {NICKNAME}, maybe we should take a step back...
Huh? It's a console just like the one in that other tower from before...

dialogue.sit:
You pull the lever.
Just like before, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape after a moment of rumbling and shaking...

dialogue.t: Hmm, it's paper tape, just like before...
Paimon still doesn't get it, but we should probably take this stuff with us in case we need it later.
What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!

dialogue.sit:
You pull the lever.
After some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...

dialogue.t: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from the Crepes Suzette Station!
All that's left now is the Pate de Fruit Station. Let's go, {NICKNAME}!
What do we have here... Right, looks like a lever with "Do NOT touch under any circumstances!" written next to it!

dialogue.sit:
You pull the lever.
After some rumbling and shaking, the machine spits out a stack of paper tape...

dialogue.t: Great! Now we have the monitoring data from both the Pate de Fruit and Crepes Suzette Stations!
{NICKNAME}, let's go back to Broglie now!

quests.description: There seem to be some peculiar, tall towers near the Fontaine Research Institute…
